environment: Python 3.14.7, Node 24.19.0, macOS; branches.py parse run through cli-runner from scratch cwd with scratch HOME; commit d29cba7 checked out in worktree sdlc/S-009-v0-cli-0

cases.title: State branch with 14 digits parses as state; near misses give null
cases.when: branches.py parse for sdlc/state-20261008101500 and nine malformed state tails (13 digits, 15 digits, empty, letters, extra parts)
cases.then: Kind state with ts string and no id; all malformed tails give kind null; exit 0; tree unchanged

cases.title: Verify branch splits into id, round, profile, part; boundaries do not give verify
cases.when: parse S-001-v0-http-api-0, S-001-v12-cli-3, S-001-v3-a-b-c-7, S-005b-v1-security-10 and eight malformed tails
cases.then: Integers for round and part; profile a-b-c whole; malformed tails are not verify
cases.expected: verify rows with integer parts; no verify for malformed
cases.actual: as expected; a trailing hyphen tail falls to slice by the slice row

cases.title: Hostile tails never crash parse
cases.given: attack-corpus families huge-integers, control-chars, flag-like-values, oversized, unicode-digits, unicode-whitespace, integer-forms, format-strings, injection, traversal, unicode-confusables (argv-safe)
cases.when: each value is placed in the round, part, attempt n, state ts and id positions: 650 CLI runs
cases.then: Every run exits 0 with ok true JSON and no traceback
cases.specSource: R-107 scenario note: parse returns a value or null and never raises

cases.title: Verify wins over slice and attempt, in all formats
cases.when: parse S-001-v0-http-api-0, S-fix-M-1-2-v1-cli-0, the same under prefix and suffix, and S-001-attempt-2-v0-cli-0
cases.then: kind verify with the right id each time

cases.title: Attempt branch gives id and integer n; malformed tails are not attempt
cases.when: parse S-001-attempt-2, S-005b-attempt-10, S-fix-M-1-2-attempt-0 and six malformed tails
cases.then: attempt with integer n; malformed are not attempt; attempt- falls to slice
cases.expected: attempt rows; no attempt for malformed

cases.title: Slice branch keeps the full id; foreign shapes give null
cases.when: parse S-001, S-fix-M-1-2, S-005b, eight null shapes, and s-001 under the lower format
cases.then: slice rows with full id; nulls; lower format gives slice

cases.title: Rows 5 to 8 classify the same under prefix and suffix formats
cases.when: parse one branch per row, plus wrong prefix and wrong suffix branches
cases.then: Same kind and parts; tail excludes prefix and suffix; wrong prefix or suffix gives null

cases.title: Without ids the CLI gives known null on rows 6 to 8
cases.when: parse slice, attempt, verify and state branches; parse under the lower format
cases.then: known is null; id keeps the branch spelling
cases.expected: known null (the CLI has no ledger input)
cases.actual: as expected; ledger known true or false is reachable only through the function, which the contract profile covers
cases.specSource: R-107 to R-109 acceptance (id and kind)

seeds.title: state row accepts a trailing newline and non-ASCII digits
seeds.detail: parse sdlc/state-20261008101500 followed by a newline gives kind state, because $ matches before a final newline. Fullwidth and Arabic-Indic digits give kind state with a non-ASCII ts. S-007 left both open.

seeds.title: CLI parse has no way to pass ledger ids
seeds.detail: branches.py parse has no --ids flag, so the known flag is always null at the CLI. The ledger check is reachable only through the function.
